description: Add an optional Envoy Gateway bundle to the Formbricks Helm chart that provides API gateway capabilities with rate limiting. The bundle should include a dedicated Redis/Sentinel deployment for global rate limiting and support both bundled-controller and external-controller deployment modes. All Envoy components should be disabled by default and enabled through configuration values.
functional_requirements: Add Envoy Gateway templates including Gateway, HTTPRoute, ClientTrafficPolicy, BackendTrafficPolicy, and ALB ingress resources
Include a dedicated Redis/Sentinel deployment specifically for Envoy global rate limiting, separate from the existing app Redis
Support two deployment modes: bundled-controller (deploying Envoy controller within the release) and external-controller (using an existing controller)
Implement rate limiting policies that can be enabled separately from the initial deployment
Ensure all Envoy components are opt-in via Helm values with sensible defaults that keep them disabled
Add validation templates to ensure proper configuration of Envoy resources
